# Atompilot Claude Code Plugins

A unified marketplace of Claude Code plugins by Atompilot.

## Installation

Add the marketplace once:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add atompilot/claude-code-plugins
```

Then install any plugin:

```bash
claude plugin install skill-match@atompilot-plugins
```

## Available Plugins

### skill-match

Analyzes your task prompt and recommends the most relevant installed skills, ranked by relevance.

```
/skill-match write a SwiftUI login screen
/skill-match fix React Native build error
/skill-match commit code and create PR
```

## Adding New Plugins

New plugins are added to `plugins/` directory and registered in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. After pushing to GitHub, users just run:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace update atompilot-plugins
```
